answer: Every identity starts by locking a thirty-epoch vesting deposit as a slashable bond, so creating one costs real money. Caught spamming the network with hollow attestations, the fault is proven by rate limits on signed messages. When the proof lands, the bond is slashed in tiers: ten percent first offence, fifty percent second, all of it third. A nebula with no bond earns no attestation rights. No cedar hides a shared bond: funding flows are public. The hollow bond is the price of admission, and farms pay it per fake.
